PLAN "12-Week Couch-to-5K Plan for Exercise-Induced Asthma with Strength - Summary"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Safe, progressive 12-week plan combining cardio progression with asthma-conscious strength work and finishers"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Tempo day intro + strength":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          run_walk 1x1.0 rpe 4 rest 0 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          goblet_squat 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        tempo_run:
          run 4x1 minutes tempo 0 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5 minutes
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Tempo progression + strength":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          run_walk 2x5 minutes run 1 minute walk 0 seconds
          goblet_squat 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        tempo_run:
          run 3x2 minutes tempo 0 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5 minutes
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Friday training 60m "Tempo endurance + strength":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          run_walk 2x6 minutes run 1 minute walk 0 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        tempo_run:
          run 4x1 minute tempo 0 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5 minutes
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Recovery tempo + mobility":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          run_walk 2x8 minutes run 2 minutes walk 0 seconds
          goblet_squat 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        tempo_run:
          walk 2 minutes, run 3x1 minute tempo, walk 1 minute
        cooldown:
          walking 5 minutes
  PHASE "Phase 2" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 70m "Tempo days + base strength":
        warmup:
          walking 6 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          run_walk 3x8 minutes run 2 minutes walk 0 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          goblet_squat 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          bent_over_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        tempo_run:
          run 3x2 minutes tempo 0 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 6 minutes
    WEEK 6:
      DAY Wednesday training 70m "Tempo progression + stability":
        warmup:
          walking 6 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          run_walk 3x10 minutes run 1 minute walk 0 seconds
          incline_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        tempo_run:
          run 4x1 minute tempo 0 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 6 minutes
    WEEK 7:
      DAY Friday training 70m "Tempo push + strength stamina":
        warmup:
          walking 6 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          run_walk 4x6 minutes run 1 minute walk 0 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        tempo_run:
          run 6x1 minute tempo 0 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 6 minutes
    WEEK 8:
      DAY Monday training 70m "Tempo peak phase 2 + intervals":
        warmup:
          walking 6 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          run_walk 3x12 minutes run 2 minutes walk 0 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          goblet_squat 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        tempo_run:
          walk 1 minute, run 4x2 minutes tempo, walk 1 minute
        cooldown:
          walking 6 minutes
  PHASE "Phase 3" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Monday training 75m "Longer steady efforts + strength":
        warmup:
          walking 6 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          run_walk 2x15 minutes run 1 minute walk 0 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        tempo_run:
          run 4x2 minutes tempo 0 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 6 minutes
    WEEK 10:
      DAY Wednesday training 75m "Threshold stepping + tempo cadence":
        warmup:
          walking 6 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          run_walk 3x12 minutes run 2 minutes walk 0 seconds
          bent_over_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          planks 3x30 seconds rpe 5 rest 30 seconds
        tempo_run:
          run 6x1 minute tempo 0 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 6 minutes
    WEEK 11:
      DAY Friday training 75m "Tempo acceleration + intervals":
        warmup:
          walking 6 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          run_walk 4x10 minutes run 2 minutes walk 0 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          lateral_raise 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        tempo_run:
          run 6x1 minute tempo 0 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 6 minutes
    WEEK 12:
      DAY Monday training 75m "5K readiness taper with tempo days":
        warmup:
          walking 6 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          run_walk 2x18 minutes run 2 minutes walk 0 seconds
          incline_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          goblet_squat 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        tempo_run:
          walk 1 minute, run 3x2 minutes tempo, walk 1 minute
        cooldown:
          walking 6 minutes

FINISHERS AND TESTS
  - Week 8 Parkrun test included as optional or scheduled test day
  - Week 4, Week 12 finishers maintain safety and form emphasis
  - Core and mobility included in cooldowns and select finisher blocks

EXERCISE VOCABULARY (use ONLY these canonical names)
walking, run_walk, dumbbell_press, goblet_squat, bent_over_row, dumbbell_row, hip_thrust, face_pull, incline_press, shoulder_press, goblet_squat, planks, lateral_raise
CARDIO MODALITIES (use ONLY these names)
